description.value: The Parsonage Cafe in Victoria's Fernwood neighbourhood is the founding location of Fernwood Coffee Company, where a 1936 Barth roaster once sat in the back and sparked a craft roasting business that went on to win the Canadian Barista Championship. The cafe has outdoor seating and serves as a neighbourhood anchor for Fernwood Coffee's specialty coffee culture. Cyclists riding through Victoria's residential streets will find it a welcoming spot for quality coffee with a genuine local history.
